import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
ok['hour']=ok.created.dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','promised_min','hour']

g['avg_check']=g.avg_check.fillna(0)
y=g.churned

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error, r2_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold, KFold
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv",parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d.actual_min.between(1,299)].copy()
ok['hour']=ok.created.dt.hour
cols=['distance_km','items','promised_min','hour']
X=ok[cols]
y=ok.actual_min>ok.promised_min
g=pd.read_csv('guests_churn.csv')
g['avg_check']=g.avg_check.fillna(0)
y=g.churned
X=pd.get_dummies(g.drop(columns=['guest_id','churned','card_blocked']),dtype=int)
X_train,X_test,y_train,y_test=train_test_split(X,y,test_size=.25,random_state=42,stratify=y)
kf=KFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=42)
model=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100,min_samples_leaf=3,random_state=0).fit(X_train,y_train)
risk=pd.Series(model.predict_proba(X_test)[:,1],index=X_test.index)
quiet=X_test[X_test.days_since_last<=45]
quiet_rate=round(y_test.loc[quiet.index].mean(),3)
k=int(len(quiet)*.1)
model_rate=round(y_test.loc[risk.loc[quiet.index].nlargest(k).index].mean(),3)
days_rate=round(y_test.loc[quiet.days_since_last.nlargest(k).index].mean(),3)
